sentences: Taffy sent the final draft last night. Taffy 昨晚寄出了最終稿。
I first heard the story from Taffy. 我最早是從這個名稱那裡聽到這個故事。

meaning: 太妃糖
sentences: The child unwrapped a piece of taffy. 那個孩子拆開了一塊太妃糖。
Warm taffy sticks to your fingers. 溫熱的太妃糖會黏在手指上。

meaning: 像太妃糖的
sentences: The melted resin became thick and taffylike. 融化的樹脂變得濃稠得像太妃糖。
Its taffylike texture made it hard to cut. 它像太妃糖般的質地讓人很難切開。

meaning: 製作太妃糖的人
sentences: The taffymaker pulled the candy by hand. 製作太妃糖的人用手拉糖。
A skilled taffymaker can judge the temperature by feel. 熟練的太妃糖師傅能靠觸感判斷溫度。

meaning: 太妃糖製作
sentences: Taffymaking filled the shop with a sweet smell. 製作太妃糖讓整間店充滿甜香。
They learned taffymaking at a seaside festival. 他們在海邊節慶上學了太妃糖製作。

meaning: 像太妃糖般地
sentences: The syrup stretched taffywise between his hands. 糖漿在他雙手間像太妃糖般延展。
The glue pulled apart taffywise in the heat. 那膠在高溫下像太妃糖般被拉開。

meaning: 塔非亞酒；甘蔗烈酒
sentences: The barrel was filled with cheap tafia. 那個木桶裝滿了便宜的塔非亞酒。
Sailors traded tafia for supplies. 水手們用塔非亞酒換取補給。

meaning: 提非納文
sentences: The guide showed us the tafinagh letters. 導遊向我們展示了提非納文字母。
She copied her name into tafinagh for practice. 她把自己的名字抄成這個名稱來練習。

meaning: 將管子末端向外展開，形成寬而薄的法蘭。
sentences: To taft means to spread the end of a pipe outward so as to form a wide thin flange. 塔夫脫意味著將管子的末端向外展開，以形成寬而薄的法蘭。
People may taft in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同的情況下採取行動。

meaning: 塔夫威茲；授權離婚
sentences: The contract mentioned tafwiz in a legal note. 合約在法律附註中提到了塔夫威茲。
They discussed tafwiz in the context of marriage law. 他們在婚姻法脈絡下討論塔夫威茲。

meaning: 標籤
sentences: Please check the price tag before you buy the expensive item. 買昂貴商品前請先檢查價格標籤。
He was tagged as a primary suspect in the international case. 他被標記（貼上標籤）為該國際案件的主要嫌疑人。

meaning: 塔加比利斯族；族名
sentences: Tagabilis is named in the survey as a local group. Tagabilis 在調查中被列為一個地方族群。
Little modern data exists on Tagabilis. 關於這個族群的現代資料很少。

meaning: 塔加卡奧洛人；族名
sentences: A speaker of Tagakaolo welcomed the visitors. 一位塔加卡奧洛人向訪客表示歡迎。
The report records several Tagakaolo traditions. 報告記錄了幾項塔加卡奧洛傳統。

meaning: 他加祿人；舊稱
sentences: The old book uses Tagal for a Filipino group. 那本舊書用這個名稱指一個菲律賓族群。
A Tagal trader appears in the travel diary. 一本遊記中出現了一位他加祿商人。

meaning: 他加拉語；舊稱
sentences: Tagala appears as an older language name in the dictionary. 字典中把這種語言列為較舊的語言名稱。
The missionary wrote several prayers in Tagala. 那位傳教士用這種語言寫了幾篇祈禱文。

meaning: 使他加祿化
sentences: The empire tried to Tagalize nearby communities. 那個政權試圖使附近社群他加祿化。
Some schools were created to Tagalize official speech. 有些學校被設立來使官方語言他加祿化。

meaning: Tagal 的變體拼法
sentences: Tagalo is a rare variant spelling in old texts. Tagalo 是舊文獻中少見的變體拼法。
The editor kept Tagalo in the quoted passage. 編者在引文中保留了這個名稱的寫法。

meaning: 他加祿語；他加祿人
sentences: She speaks Tagalog at home with her grandparents. 她在家裡和祖父母說他加祿語。
The movie includes a few lines in Tagalog. 那部電影裡有幾句他加祿語台詞。

meaning: 木苜蓿；樹苜蓿
sentences: The farmer planted tagasaste for fodder. 那位農夫種了木苜蓿當飼料。
Tagasaste grows well in dry soil. 木苜蓿在乾燥土壤中長得很好。

meaning: 西猯屬
sentences: Tagassu is the genus name on the specimen label. Tagassu 是標本標籤上的屬名。
The curator compared Tagassu with related genera. 館長把這個分類與相關屬做比較。

meaning: 西猯科
sentences: Tagassuidae appears in the family section of the atlas. Tagassuidae 出現在圖鑑的科名部分。
Students learned that Tagassuidae includes peccaries. 學生學到這個分類包含西猯類。

meaning: 塔格糖
sentences: This drink is sweetened with tagatose instead of sugar. 這杯飲料是用塔格糖而不是砂糖調甜的。
Tagatose has become popular in low-calorie foods. 塔格糖在低熱量食品中越來越受歡迎。

meaning: 塔高爾族；族名
sentences: Tagaur is identified as an ethnic name in the note. 附註把這個族群標示為一個族名。
The archive preserves only a brief mention of Tagaur. 檔案中只保留了對這個族群的簡短提及。

meaning: 塔格巴努亞人；族名
sentences: A Tagbanua elder told the story by the fire. 一位塔格巴努亞長者在火邊講了那個故事。
The museum features Tagbanua baskets and carvings. 博物館展示塔格巴努亞人的籃器與雕刻。

meaning: 厚卡紙
sentences: We used tagboard to make the poster base. 我們用厚卡紙做海報底板。
The model was cut from white tagboard. 那個模型是用白色厚卡紙裁成的。

meaning: 萬壽菊屬
sentences: Tagetes blooms brightly through the summer. 萬壽菊屬植物整個夏天都開得很鮮豔。
The gardener planted Tagetes along the path. 園丁沿著小路種了萬壽菊屬植物。

meaning: 萬壽菊醇
sentences: The oil contains a small amount of tagetol. 這種精油含有少量萬壽菊醇。
Chemists isolated tagetol from the flower extract. 化學家從花朵萃取物中分離出萬壽菊醇。

meaning: 標籤色調
sentences: The old chart used a dull tagetone for warning labels. 那張舊圖表用一種暗淡的標籤色調來做警示標記。
She matched the booklet cover to the tagetone on the box. 她把小冊子的封面配成和盒子上的標籤色調一致。

meaning: 有標籤；標記。
sentences: All the tagged items are on sale. 所有標記的商品均在促銷。
The report describes the result as tagged. 該報告將結果描述為已標記。

meaning: 貼標籤的人；標記器
sentences: The factory hired a tagger to label each bundle by hand. 工廠雇了一名貼標籤的人手工標記每一捆貨。
This tagger prints clean codes on small packages. 這台標記器能在小包裝上印出清晰的代碼。

meaning: 使纏結；使混亂
sentences: Do not taggle the ropes before the boat leaves. 船開走前不要把繩子弄得纏成一團。
A rushed move can taggle the fishing lines in seconds. 匆忙的動作幾秒內就會把釣線弄亂。

meaning: 破舊零亂的；滿是碎布條的
sentences: His old coat looked taggy after the long trip. 他那件舊外套經過長途旅行後看起來破舊零亂。
The scarecrow wore a taggy hat in the field. 稻草人戴著一頂破破爛爛的帽子站在田裡。

meaning: 塔格利克人；塔格利克語
sentences: The archive lists Taghlik among the small northern groups. 檔案把這個名稱列為北方的小族群之一。
A few elders still remember words from Taghlik. 仍有幾位長者記得一些這個名稱的詞語。

meaning: 塔吉萊石，一種礦物
sentences: The collector placed a piece of tagilite under the lamp. 收藏家把一塊塔吉萊石放到燈下。
Tagilite showed a pale shine on the broken surface. 塔吉萊石在斷面上呈現淡淡的光澤。

meaning: 塔吉什人；塔吉什語
sentences: The guide spoke about Tagish history during the tour. 導覽員在參觀途中談到這個概念的歷史。
Researchers recorded several songs in Tagish. 研究人員錄下了幾首這種語言歌曲。

meaning: 小標籤
sentences: Each seed packet had a taglet tied to the top. 每包種子頂端都繫著一張小標籤。
He wrote the sample number on a paper taglet. 他把樣本編號寫在一張紙製小標籤上。

meaning: 塔利亞科齊式的；鼻整形術相關的
sentences: The paper describes a Tagliacotian method of repair. 那篇論文描述了一種塔利亞科齊式的修補方法。
The surgeon studied Tagliacotian techniques in old texts. 那位外科醫師在古老文獻中研究塔利亞科齊式技術。

meaning: 塔利亞科齊傳統的；整形外科相關的
sentences: The museum displayed Tagliacozzian surgical drawings. 博物館展示了這個分類的外科圖稿。
His lecture compared modern and Tagliacozzian practice. 他的演講比較了現代做法與這個分類傳統。

meaning: 像標籤的
sentences: A taglike strip hung from the bag handle. 一條像標籤的細帶垂在袋把上。
The leaf has a narrow, taglike shape. 那片葉子有狹長而像標籤的形狀。

meaning: 糾結的一團；纏結
sentences: She cut through the taglock in the wool with scissors. 她用剪刀剪開羊毛裡糾結的一團。
A taglock of wire blocked the small drain. 一團纏結的鐵絲堵住了小排水口。

meaning: 破衣爛衫；衣衫襤褸的人
sentences: He arrived in tagrag after weeks on the road. 他在路上奔波數週後穿著破衣爛衫到達。
The costume shop sold a comic tagrag for the play. 戲服店為那齣戲賣一套滑稽的破爛裝。

meaning: 襤褸；破爛狀態
sentences: The director wanted a touch of tagraggery in the costume design. 導演希望戲服設計帶一點襤褸感。

meaning: 被磨痛的；擦傷的
sentences: My neck felt tagsore after the stiff collar rubbed all day. 僵硬的領口磨了一整天後，我的脖子覺得被磨痛了。
The dog became tagsore where the rough tag touched its skin. 粗糙的牌子碰到皮膚的地方讓那隻狗磨得發痛。

meaning: 尾端標記；尾部附片
sentences: The kite had a bright tagtail for balance. 那只風箏有一條鮮亮的尾端附片來保持平衡。
He spotted the tagtail on the end of the cable. 他看到纜線末端的尾部標記。

meaning: 象牙椰子堅果；象牙椰
sentences: The artisan carved a button from tagua. 那位工匠用象牙椰子堅果雕了一顆鈕扣。
Tagua is often used as a plant-based ivory. Tagua 常被當作植物性象牙使用。

meaning: 鼯鼠
sentences: A taguan glided between the tall trees at dusk. 黃昏時，一隻鼯鼠在高樹間滑翔。
The children watched the taguan from a quiet platform. 孩子們在安靜的平台上看著那隻鼯鼠。

meaning: 塔古拉島
sentences: The boat route passes near Tagula in calm weather. 天氣平穩時，船線會經過這個地方附近。
A storm delayed supplies bound for Tagula. 一場風暴延誤了運往這個地方的補給。

meaning: 一日工；一天的工作量
sentences: He counted one full tagwerk before taking a rest. 他做滿一整天的工後才休息。
The old record lists the rent in grain and tagwerk. 舊紀錄以穀物和一日工來列出租賦。

meaning: 側面；一邊
sentences: Paint only one taha of the wooden sign. 只要把木牌的一邊上漆。
The crack runs along the taha of the bowl. 那道裂縫沿著碗的側面延伸。

meaning: 塔哈米人；塔哈米語
sentences: The notes mention Tahami as a regional language. 筆記把這種語言記為一種地方語言。
A scholar compared Tahami vocabulary with nearby dialects. 一位學者把這種語言詞彙和附近方言作了比較。

meaning: 芝麻醬
sentences: She stirred taheen into the soup for a nutty flavor. 她把芝麻醬拌進湯裡，增加堅果香味。
The market sells fresh taheen in small jars. 市場用小罐販售新鮮的芝麻醬。

meaning: 塔希爾，一種傳統重量單位
sentences: The merchant weighed the silver by the tahil. 商人以這個名稱這種傳統重量單位來秤銀子。
One tahil was enough for the small trade. 一個這個名稱的重量就足夠完成這筆小交易。

meaning: 芝麻醬
sentences: He spread tahin on warm bread at breakfast. 他早餐把芝麻醬抹在熱麵包上。
A spoon of tahin made the sauce smoother. 一匙芝麻醬讓醬汁變得更順口。

meaning: 大溪地
sentences: They planned a winter trip to Tahiti. 他們計畫冬天去這個地方旅行。
The postcard from Tahiti showed a bright lagoon. 那張從這個名稱寄來的明信片上有明亮的潟湖。

meaning: 大溪地人；大溪地語
sentences: She learned a Tahitian song for the festival. 她為節慶學了一首這種語言歌曲。
The museum has a Tahitian drum on display. 博物館正在展示一面這個名稱鼓。

meaning: 地窖；地下室
sentences: The jars were stored in a cool tahkhana. 那些罐子被存放在涼爽的地窖裡。
They hid the old books beneath the house in a tahkhana. 他們把舊書藏在屋下的地下室裡。

meaning: 塔爾坦人；塔爾坦語
sentences: The exhibit included a map of Tahltan territory. 展覽中包含一張這個地方傳統領地的地圖。
A teacher introduced basic Tahltan greetings to the class. 老師向全班介紹了基本的這個名稱問候語。

meaning: 塔爾羊；野山羊
sentences: A tahr stood on the steep cliff without fear. 一隻塔爾羊毫不畏懼地站在陡峭的山崖上。
The ranger showed us tracks left by a tahr. 管理員指給我們看一隻塔爾羊留下的足跡。

meaning: 稅務區官員；收稅官
sentences: The farmers brought their papers to the tahseeldar. 農民把文件帶去交給稅務區官員。
A strict tahseeldar checked every land record. 一位嚴格的收稅官檢查了每一份土地紀錄。

meaning: 稅務區；行政分區
sentences: The village belongs to a large tahsil in the north. 那個村莊屬於北方一個大的稅務分區。
The report lists population figures for each tahsil. 報告列出了每個行政分區的人口數字。

meaning: 稅務區官員；收稅官
sentences: The tahsildar arrived early to inspect the files. 那位稅務區官員很早就到場檢查檔案。
People waited outside the office to meet the tahsildar. 人們在辦公室外等著見那位收稅官。

meaning: 塔辛，名字
sentences: Tahsin signed the letter at the bottom of the page. Tahsin 在頁面底部簽了名。
We met Tahsin during the language workshop. 我們在語言工作坊認識了這種語言。

meaning: 祭司；專家工匠
sentences: The village asked a tahua to bless the canoe. 村民請一位祭司為獨木舟祝福。
Only a skilled tahua could finish that carving. 只有熟練的專家工匠才能完成那件雕刻。

meaning: 台語族；台人
sentences: The book traces the migration of Tai peoples. 這本書追溯了這個族群諸民族的遷徙。
Several Tai languages are spoken across the region. 這個地區有數種這種語言語言被使用。

meaning: 台，一種傳統單位
sentences: The jeweler measured the gold in tai. 珠寶商以這個名稱這種傳統單位來計量黃金。
Half a tai was enough for the pendant. 做那個墜子用半個這個名稱就夠了。

meaning: 毛利長矛杖
sentences: The performer held a taiaha during the dance. 表演者在舞蹈時握著一把毛利長矛杖。
A carved taiaha hung on the meeting hall wall. 一把雕刻精美的毛利長矛杖掛在會堂的牆上。

meaning: 小釘；短尖樁
sentences: He fixed the mat with a small taich at each corner. 他在每個角落用一枚小釘固定墊子。
The carpenter dropped a taich on the floor. 那位木匠把一枚短尖樁掉在地上。

meaning: 泰加林；針葉林帶
sentences: The train crossed miles of taiga before dawn. 火車在天亮前穿越了數英里的泰加林。
Few roads cut through the dense taiga. 幾乎沒有道路穿過那片茂密的針葉林帶。

meaning: 糾纏；拖拉不清
sentences: Do not taigle over a decision that is already clear. 對已經很清楚的決定不要再拖拉糾纏。
They taigled with the same small issue all morning. 他們整個早上都在同一個小問題上糾纏不清。

meaning: 愛糾纏的；拖拖拉拉的
sentences: His taiglesome style slowed the whole meeting. 他拖拖拉拉的作風讓整場會議慢了下來。
The debate became taiglesome and unproductive. 那場辯論變得愛糾纏又沒有成效。

meaning: 慢著；別急
sentences: Taihoa, we should read the map again. 慢著，我們應該再看一次地圖。
The guide called out, "Taihoa," before anyone moved. 嚮導在大家動身前喊了一聲「慢著」。

meaning: 客棧；茶館
sentences: Travelers rested in a taikhana beside the road. 旅人們在路旁的一間客棧休息。
They met at a quiet taikhana near the market. 他們在市場附近一間安靜的茶館碰面。

meaning: 尾巴
sentences: The happy dog wagged its tail when its owner came home. 當主人回家時，開心的狗搖起了尾巴。
The cat's long tail was twitching with excitement. 貓的長尾巴因興奮而抽動著。

meaning: 尾數費；按尾數計的費用
sentences: The farmer paid tailage for each animal in the herd. 農夫為牛群中的每一頭牲口繳了按尾數計的費用。
Old accounts recorded tailage beside the grazing tax. 舊帳冊把尾數費記在放牧稅旁邊。

meaning: 書脊飾帶；尾帶

meaning: 後擋板
sentences: He lowered the tailboard to unload the crates. 他放下後擋板來卸貨箱。
Mud splashed across the truck's tailboard. 泥水濺滿了卡車的後擋板。

meaning: 有尾的
sentences: The drawing showed a tailed creature with wings. 那張圖畫顯示一隻有尾的有翼生物。
A tailed comet appeared low in the evening sky. 一顆帶著長尾的彗星出現在傍晚天空低處。

meaning: 末位者；殿後者
sentences: The tailender crossed the finish line well after the leaders. 那名末位者在領先者之後很久才通過終點。
Even the tailender received applause from the crowd. 連最後一名都獲得了群眾的掌聲。

meaning: 尾隨者；尾部部件
sentences: A suspicious tailer followed the reporter through the station. 一名可疑的尾隨者穿過車站跟著那位記者。
The machine needs a new tailer at the back. 那台機器後方需要一個新的尾部部件。

meaning: 小尾巴
sentences: The costume had a short tailet sewn to the back. 那套服裝後面縫著一條短小尾巴。

meaning: 教師身分
sentences: Parenthood changed her sense of teacherhood. 成為父母後，她對教師身分的感受改變了。
The essay reflects on duty and teacherhood. 那篇文章反思責任與教師身分。

meaning: 無教師的
sentences: The class felt teacherless after the sudden leave. 老師突然請假後，這班像是失去了老師。
A teacherless room grew noisy fast. 沒有老師的教室很快就吵了起來。

meaning: 像教師的
sentences: His calm voice sounded teacherlike. 他平靜的聲音聽起來很像老師。

Her teachery smile made the interns sit straighter. 她那帶著教師味的微笑讓實習生坐得更直。

sentences: The guide was so vague that the lesson felt teachless. 那位講解者太含糊，讓整堂課像是沒有教學可言。

meaning: 教學

meaning: 茶杯
sentences: A blue teacup sat beside the kettle. 一只藍色茶杯放在水壺旁邊。
She warmed the teacup before pouring. 她倒茶前先把茶杯溫熱。

sentences: Add one teacupful of milk to the pot. 往壺裡加入一茶杯的牛奶。
He measured a teacupful of rice by eye. 他目測量出一茶杯的米。

meaning: 古文獻中的術語

meaning: 易撕裂性
sentences: The designer tested the tearableness of the thin fabric. 設計師測試了這種薄布料的易撕裂性。

meaning: 容易撕裂地
sentences: The cloth split tearably along the weak seam. 這塊布沿著脆弱的接縫很容易地裂開了。

meaning: 撕裂者

meaning: 巨大的;規模大或影響大

meaning: 無淚的

meaning: 無淚地
sentences: She spoke tearlessly about the hard year. 她無淚地談起那艱難的一年。

meaning: 無淚狀態
sentences: His tearlessness made him seem unusually calm. 他的無淚狀態讓他看起來異常冷靜。

meaning: 可逗弄性

sentences: The email had a temptatory subject line. 那封電子郵件用了引誘性的主旨。

meaning: 引誘者
sentences: In the tale, the tempter appears as a stranger. 在故事裡，引誘者以陌生人的身分出現。

sentences: The warm bread smelled tempting. 熱麵包聞起來很誘人。

meaning: 誘人之處

meaning: 女誘惑者

He feared the temptress more than the thief. 他害怕那名女誘惑者勝過小偷。

meaning: 天平
sentences: Tempyo was an important era in early Japanese history. 天平是日本早期歷史中的重要年號。
The statue is often dated to the Tempyo period. 這座雕像常被定年為天平時期。

meaning: 篩子
sentences: He poured the grain through a temse. 他把穀物倒過一個篩子。
The old temse hung on the barn wall. 那個舊篩子掛在穀倉牆上。

meaning: 篩分者
sentences: The temser removed the stones from the flour. 篩分者把石子從麵粉中挑出。
An experienced temser works quickly and cleanly. 有經驗的篩分者做事又快又乾淨。

meaning: 醉態
sentences: His temulence was obvious after midnight. 午夜過後，他的醉態很明顯。
The guard refused entry because of her temulence. 守衛因她的醉態而拒絕她進入。

meaning: 醉態
sentences: The captain criticized the sailor for temulency on duty. 船長責備那名水手值勤時的醉態。
Temulency ruined the mood of the dinner. 醉態破壞了晚餐的氣氛。

meaning: 醉醺醺的
sentences: A temulent guest knocked over a chair. 一名醉醺醺的客人撞倒了一張椅子。
He looked temulent and confused. 他看起來醉醺醺又困惑。

meaning: 醉醺醺地

She laughed temulently and lost her balance. 她醉醺醺地笑著，失去了平衡。

meaning: 十
sentences: There are ten students in the small class. 這個小班級有十個學生。
The project will be completed in ten days. 該專案將在十天內完成。

meaning: 可維持性
sentences: We questioned the tenability of the plan. 我們質疑這個計畫的可維持性。
The lawyer defended the tenability of the claim. 律師為該主張的站得住腳性辯護。

meaning: 站得住腳的
sentences: Your argument is tenable if the data are accurate. 如果資料正確，你的論點就是站得住腳的。
The village is barely tenable in winter. 那座村莊在冬天幾乎難以維持。

meaning: 可維持性
sentences: The tenableness of the shelter depends on clean water. 這個避難所的可維持性取決於乾淨的水源。
We debated the tenableness of their position. 我們辯論了他們立場的可維持性。

meaning: 站得住腳地
sentences: He argued tenably against the proposal. 他有理有據地反對那項提案。
The cabin was tenably supplied for one more week. 那間小屋的補給還能勉強維持一週。

meaning: 夾持牌勢
sentences: She won the hand with a classic tenace. 她以經典的夾持牌勢贏下那一墩。
The coach explained how tenace works in bridge. 教練解釋了橋牌中的夾持牌勢如何運作。

meaning: 緊貼物體或表面；黏合劑。
sentences: The report describes the result as tenacious. 報告稱這項結果是頑強的。
Everyone noticed the tenacious tone of the message. 所有人都注意到了這條消息的語氣中的堅韌。

meaning: 堅韌地
sentences: He tenaciously pursued the truth. 他堅韌地追查真相。
The vine tenaciously clung to the wall. 藤蔓緊緊地攀附在牆上。

meaning: 頑強
sentences: Her tenaciousness impressed the whole team. 她的頑強讓整個團隊印象深刻。
The tenaciousness of the glue surprised me. 那種膠的黏著頑強程度讓我驚訝。

meaning: 韌性
sentences: Success often requires tenacity. 成功往往需要韌性。
The climber showed great tenacity on the final slope. 那名登山者在最後的坡段展現出極大堅持。

meaning: 鉤狀手術器
sentences: The surgeon lifted the tissue with a tenaculum. 外科醫師用鉤狀手術器抬起組織。

meaning: 傳統小舟
sentences: The fisherman repaired his tenai before dawn. 漁夫在黎明前修理他的傳統小舟。

meaning: 夾形防禦工事
sentences: The old fort still had a stone tenaille. 那座古堡仍保有石造的夾形防禦工事。
Engineers studied the tenaille in the battle map. 工程師研究戰圖中的夾形防禦工事。

meaning: 小型夾形堡
sentences: A tenaillon protected the outer wall. 一座小型夾形堡保護著外牆。
The guide pointed out the ruined tenaillon. 導覽員指出那座毀損的小型夾形堡。

meaning: 特納克塔克
sentences: Tenaktak sits on a remote northern shore. 特納克塔克位於偏遠的北方海岸。
Only a few maps mark Tenaktak clearly. 只有少數地圖清楚標出特納克塔克。

meaning: 租賃，租期
sentences: The tenancy agreement outlines the rules for the rented property. 租賃協議概述了租賃財產的規則。
The project was completed during his tenancy as manager. 該專案在他擔任經理的任期（租期/在職期間）內完成了。

meaning: 租戶、房客
sentences: The new tenants moved into the small wooden cottage earlier this morning. 新租戶今天清晨搬進了那座小木屋。
Our landlord is very reasonable and always responds quickly to his tenants. 我們的房東非常通情達理，總是能迅速回應他的房客（租戶）。

meaning: 適於出租的
sentences: The flat is clean and tenantable now. 那間公寓現在乾淨到可以出租入住。
After repairs, the cottage became tenantable again. 經過修繕後，那間小屋又適合居住了。

meaning: 可出租性
sentences: The tenantableness of the building improved after renovation. 翻修後，那棟建築的可出租性提高了。
They assessed the tenantableness of each room. 他們評估每個房間的可出租性。

meaning: 承租人

Our records show the previous tenanter left in June. 我們的紀錄顯示前任承租人在六月搬走。

meaning: 佃租制度

meaning: 無租戶的

meaning: 像房客的
sentences: He had a tenantlike caution around the landlord. 他在房東面前有種像房客般的拘謹。

meaning: 租戶群
sentences: The estate kept a record of its tenantry. 那座莊園保存著租戶群的紀錄。

meaning: 房客身分

meaning: 丁鱥

meaning: 丁鱥草
sentences: Tenchweed spread across the pond in summer. 夏天時丁鱥草蔓延整個池塘。
The fish hid under the tenchweed. 魚躲在丁鱥草下面。

meaning: 坦克特里人
sentences: The Tencteri were an ancient Germanic tribe. 坦克特里人是古代的日耳曼部族。

meaning: 趨向

meaning: 趨勢

meaning: 趨勢

meaning: 傾向性的

meaning: 帶偏向地

meaning: 偏頗

meaning: 標

He worded the complaint tenderably for the board. 他把申訴寫得適合提交給董事會。

meaning: 受標人
sentences: The tenderee reviewed the purchase offer carefully. 受標人仔細審閱那份購買提議。

meaning: 投標人

meaning: 腱狀特性

meaning: 肌腱與黏液組織的

meaning: 肌腱
sentences: He tore a tendon in his ankle during the match. 他在比賽中弄斷了腳踝的肌腱。

meaning: 腱的

meaning: 肌腱修補術

meaning: 溫柔

meaning: 腱鞘的

meaning: 腱鞘炎

meaning: 柔情

meaning: 卷鬚

meaning: 有卷鬚的

meaning: 生有卷鬚的

meaning: 卷鬚的
sentences: The leaf had a thin tendrillar tip. 那片葉子有細長的卷鬚狀尖端。

meaning: 特提斯海的；與特提斯洋有關的

sentences: Tethys is the name of a sea goddess in Greek myth. Tethys 是希臘神話中的一位海洋女神之名。
Geologists also use Tethys for an ancient ocean. 地質學家也用這個名稱來指稱古代海洋。

meaning: 提頓；提頓族
sentences: The map showed the Teton range under fresh snow. 地圖上顯示積著新雪的這個族群山脈。

meaning: 南美鯽魚科和西非鰍魚科的眾多小型淡水魚中的一種，在家庭水族箱中很受歡迎
sentences: The specimen was classified as tetra after the lab compared its features. 實驗室比較特徵後，將該標本歸入這個分類。

meaning: 疑似非標準或極罕見拼寫；正式使用前應再查證

sentences: The chemist explained the tetrabasicity of the compound. 化學家解釋了該化合物的四鹼性。

meaning: 四牙象屬

meaning: 四牙古象類動物

meaning: 四書占星論，古代占星著作
sentences: He mentioned the Tetrabiblos while discussing ancient astrology, using the word tetrabiblos in lowercase as listed. 他在討論古代占星術時提到《四書占星論》，並依清單使用小寫形式的書名。

sentences: The report described a tetraboric compound in the sample. 報告描述了樣本中的一種四硼酸類化合物。

meaning: 有四鰓的
sentences: The zoologist called the animal tetrabranch in an old classification. 動物學家在一種舊分類中把那種動物稱為有四鰓的。

meaning: 四鰓亞綱，四鰓類
sentences: Older textbooks placed nautilus-like animals in Tetrabranchia. 較早的教科書把鸚鵡螺樣的動物歸入四鰓類。

meaning: 四溴化物

meaning: 四心皮的

meaning: 四角的

meaning: 四射珊瑚類

meaning: 四射珊瑚類的

meaning: 四射骨針海綿目

meaning: 四射骨針海綿目的成員

meaning: 四射骨針海綿目的

meaning: 具四射骨針的

meaning: 四指趾的
sentences: The fossil bird had a tetradactyl foot. 那隻化石鳥有四指趾的足部。

meaning: 四指趾的
